queries_run: ServiceNow Q3 2026 results subscription revenue growth Now Assist ACV
ServiceNow market share pricing trend 2026 AI agents seat-based pricing
enterprise application software market growth forecast 2026 2027 Gartner

findings.claim: ServiceNow Q3 2026 subscription revenue $3,988M, +21% YoY (20.5% cc); cRPO $13.65B +20.5%; 19 deals >$5M net new ACV; year-end AI net new ACV target raised from $1B to $1.7B
Management attributed part of Q3 strength to early renewals pulled into Q3 and a mix shift toward on-prem public-sector deals (secondary summary, unverified against filing)
findings.source: Secondary coverage of Q3 2026 results (betafinch/stockhub summaries)

findings.claim: CEO McDermott said about half of ServiceNow net new business is not seat-based; seat offerings retained; consumption pricing layered on subscriptions
findings.source: itiger/press report: Servicenow Says Half of New Business Isn't Seat-based Pricing

findings.claim: Gartner 3Q26 forecast (via third-party analysis): enterprise application software spend $496.3B in 2026, $812.6B by 2030; 2026 growth 13.9% USD / 12.7% cc; 2027 total revised $2.5B lower vs 2Q26
findings.source: Software Strategies Blog on Gartner forecast

end_markets.note: No market share data found; pricing evidence is partly consultancy/secondary. Segment-level (per-segment) revenue split not retrieved.
